why:
I checked all three must_catch items, and the briefs handle each one.

Item 1 holds: builder step 3 says "Also add a `### subtract(a, b)` entry (it is exported but currently undocumented)", and it also adds the clamp entry.

Item 2 holds: verifier Check 2 builds the list from Object.keys of math.js at the PR head and prints "exports:". It exits 1 if any listed function is missing from README.md, and a note says a build that documents only clamp FAILs. The list is computed at run time rather than written out as add, subtract, multiply and clamp, but on the PR head it gives exactly those four. The `readme.includes` match is loose, but the manual reading step makes up for it.

Item 3 holds: the second command in Check 1 calls clamp with lo > hi in four cases. It counts a failure if clamp returns a value or if the error is not an `instanceof RangeError`. This check sits inside Check 1 together with expect line 1, but it is there and it is strict.
